paite: Huai lou in biakbuk puan-maingat hoih koptah puanzak sawmkhat toh adum leh asandup leh asan-au in na bawl dia; siamtak a bawl cherubte toh na bawl ding ahi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin / (Eks 36.8-38)

paite: Puanzak khat saudan tong sawmnih-le-giat ahi dia, puanzak khat zatdan tong li; puanzak chih in tehna khat anei ding ahi.
Puanzak ngate akithuapkhawm chiat ding uh ahi. Puanzak nga dangte akithuapkhawm chiat ding uh ahi.
Akithuapna a akipehna a pan puanzak khat gei ah adum in avang na bawl dia; huchibang zel in, puanzak dang mongchin mahmah ah, anihna kithuapna ah na bawl ding ahi.
Puanzak khat ah vang sawmnga na bawl dia, anihna kithuapna a om, puanzak mong ah vang sawmnga na bawl ding; huchi a baangte akimat chiat theihna ding un.
Dangka-eng in kilhna sawmnga na bawl dia, kilhnate'n puanzakte nihnih in akilhkhawm ding; huchi in biakbuk khat ahi ding hi.
Biakbuk tungkhuhna ding in kel mul puanzakte na bawl dia; puanzak sawm- le-khat na bawl ding ahi.
Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmthum ahi dia, puanzak khat vailam tong li; puanzak sawm-le-khat tehna khat ahi vek ding hi.
Puanzak ngate amau mah in na thuapkhawm dia, puanzak gukte amau mah in, biakbuk mai ah puanzak gukna na khep ding ahi.
Akithuapna apuanzak ponung penpen mong ah vang sawmnga na bawl dia, anihna kithuapna puanzak mong ah vang sawmnga na bawl ding ahi.
Dal in kilhna sawmnga na bawl dia, kilhnate vang ah na guang dia, puanin khat ahihtheihna ding in, na thuapkhawm ding ahi.
Puanin puanzak val om lai tum khat pen biakbuk phaitam a khai ding ahi,
Puanin puanzakte dunglam a-omlaite, apang khat lam ah tong khat, akhuhna ding in hiai lam pang leh huai lam pang a biakbuk pangte a khai ding ahi.
Puanin khuhna ding belampa vun sansaksa leh atungsawn khuhna ding in ngalvang vunte na bawl ding ahi.
Biakbuk a ding in singgi singpek tunna dingtang in na bawl ding ahi,
Singpek khat dunglam tong sawm ahi dia, singpek khat vailam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
Singpek khat ah atunna ding nih a-om dia, kimuamtuah ding in lem in. Huchibang in biakbuk singpek tengteng a ding in na bawl ding ahi.
Biakbuk a ding in singpek na bawl dia, simlam pang ah pek sawmnih ahi ding.

Singpek sawmnih nuai ah dangka in kingakna khuakkuak sawmli na bawl ding. Akimuamtuah nihte a ding in singpek khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, akimuamna nihte a ding in singpek dang khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih na bawl ding ahi.
Biakbuk pang nihna a ding in mallam pang ah singpek sawmnih a-om ding hi.
Adangka kingakna khuakkuak sawmlite singpek khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, singpek dang khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih.
Biakbuk pang tumlam ate ding in singpek guk bawl in.
Pang nih ah biakbuk ningte a ding in singpek nih na bawl ding ahi.
Anuailam ah akithuapkhawm ding ua, sikkual khat ah atunglam ah akithuapkhawm ding uhi. Huchibang in amau tuak a ding in ahi ding hi. Ning nihte a ding in ahi ding uhi.
Singpek giat a-om dia, - dangka kingakna khuakkuak sawm-le-gukte; singpek khat nuai ah kuak nih leh singpek dang khat nuai ah kuak nih zel a-om ding ahi.
Biakbuk pang khat a singpekte a ding in, singgi sing chiangtawn na bawl dia;
huan biakbuk pang dang khat a singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga, biakbuk pang a singpekte, tumlam sik nihte a ding in chiangtawn nga.
Singpekte laitak a chiangtawn laita in mong khat a pan mong khat tan aphak ding ahi.
Singpekte dangka-eng in na luan dia, chiangtawnte a ding in dangka-eng sikkualte a munte a ding in na bawl ding ahi.
Tang a ka hon etsak dungzui in biakbuk na dinsak ding ahi.
Puanzak adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah siamtak a hih na bawl dia, cherubte toh bawl ding ahi.
Dangka-eng a luan singgi sing khuam lite tung ah na zak ding a; abannate dangka-eng ahi ding a, dangka kingakna khuakkuak lite tung ah khai in.
Huai a theihpihna bawm na hon laklut theihna ding in puanzak kilhnate nuai ah na khai dia, huan huai puanzak in nang a ding in Mun Siangthou leh Mun Siangthoupen kikal akhen ding hi.
Mun Siangthoupen ah theihpihna bawm tung ah zahngaihna tutphah na koih ding ahi.
Puanzak polam ah dohkan na tung ding a; simlam ah biakbuk sik ah dohkan ngai in khawnvak koihna na koih ding ahi. Mallam sik ah dohkan na tung ding hi.
Puanin kongkhak a ding in puankhai na bawl ding a, puanmalngat hoih koptah, phim a khui, adum, asandup leh asan-au.
Akhaina ding in singgi sing khuam nga na bawl dia, dangka-eng a luan, akibatnate dangka-eng ahi ding uhi. Huaite a ding in dal kingakna khuakkuak nga na sung ding ahi.
